notes.title: Machine Mind Playtest has already begun!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/d57b4486aeb6f30a70bf69e6f0e2d7a6e53a5d76.png"][/img][/p][p]The number of participants is limited, so check your email soon![/p][p]Please note that each player can invite up to three friends! We are looking forward to your feedback, and we would greatly appreciate it if you could share a video of your gaming session through the feedback form![/p][p]Sign up for playtest now, and don't forget to wishlist:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Machine Mind Playtest launches this Friday!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/d57b4486aeb6f30a70bf69e6f0e2d7a6e53a5d76.png"][/img][/p][p]We're excited to announce the next Machine Mind, which will be launched this Friday![/p][p]For at least a week you'll have an opportunity to try out the latest version of the game, in which we implemented several features based on your feedback, which includes:[/p][p]- Lightning Rod that protects your base during a storm[/p][p]- Moving and copy-pasting buildings[/p][p]- Progression system changes[/p][p]- More information in the Journal[/p][p]Besides that you'll be able to check out several more unannounced new features — we'll shed a light on them later. And thanks to your participation in previous playtests, we were able to locate and fix a lot of small and critical bugs![/p][p]We hope you'll enjoy the new version and we'll be happy to hear your feedback![/p][p]Sign up for playtest now, and don't forget to wishlist:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Machine Mind Concept art - major points of interest
notes.content: [p]The Machine Mind development is in full swing! Meanwhile, here's some more concept art - major points of interest, which usually contain a high concentration of resources with a higher concentration of those who's going to protect it by any cost![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/607ed8515c42c5c19e21de599aa2e22a9dbae33a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/c9fcb13a22be9b6a6b9ae4107c1232d0fa554a19.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/d5ecb67a06f10f6809e51af85223aecfe37c7a27.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Machine Mind concept art - abandoned vehicles of the lost civilization
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/6aded57abf0e93fc597fe18bff625e5f6debf86e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Such machines can be found in various places on the map, usually in the few ruins of the old civilization that have not yet been completely destroyed and covered with sand. Although they cannot be dismantled for spare parts, they can be recycled into scrap metal![/p]

notes.title: Machine Mind at Tiny Teams 2025!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/0c778116c5b0ee5eb50a88a66e659c51b6dd775f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get ready for a post-apocalyptic adventure — the demo of Machine Mind, an action game with elements of survival and RTS, is taking part in the Tiny Teams 2025 festival on Steam from August 7 to 14.[/p][p]Try the demo now: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Second Machine Mind playtest is concluded!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/bd49d7bcacee821d81bf543d39e25a5e8748ddf4.png"][/img][/p][p]The Second Machine Mind playtest is concluded![/p][p]Thank you to all participants for your interest, we greatly appreciate your feedback! Let's make the game better together![/p]

notes.title: The second playtest of Machine Mind has begun!
notes.content: [p]The playtest runs from July 18 to July 25 — you’ll have a full week to explore the updated game world![/p][p]Don’t forget: each participant gets 3 invites to bring friends into the playtest.[/p][p]If you still don't have the access, don't worry — we will be inviting more and more players, so don't forget to check your email![/p][p]Are you a content creator interested in reviewing Machine Mind? Apply now to get access to the playtest: [url="https://forms.gle/CEJ6UqyboepXFHWr6"]https://forms.gle/CEJ6UqyboepXFHWr6[/url][/p][p][/p][p]You can check if you got the access to the playtest on the game’s page:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Watch the playtest trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="PON3GDW7PvY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The playtest has been postponed for one day
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/bd49d7bcacee821d81bf543d39e25a5e8748ddf4.png"][/img][/p][p]In order to thoroughly polish the version of the game you are about to explore, we had to make the hard decision to postpone the playtest launch by one day.[/p][p]However, we also revised the length of the playtest: you will now have a full week to try out the game![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't signed up for the playtest yet, now's the time to do it:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: We're launching the second playtest of Machine Mind!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/bd49d7bcacee821d81bf543d39e25a5e8748ddf4.png"][/img][/p][p]We're launching the second playtest of Machine Mind — join in![/p][p]The test will run from July 17 to 21, and you could be among the first to explore the updated world of the game.[/p][p]The map has expanded with new locations, plus we've added new weapons and building tools. Explore, fight, build — there are now even more possibilities![/p][p]Took part in the first playtest? Great — you'll get automatic access to the second one.[/p][p]Each participant will also receive 3 invites to bring friends — uncover the secrets of a ruined world and share your experiences![/p][p][/p][p]Want to join? Just visit the game's page and click "Request Access":[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind"][/dynamiclink] Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist — there's a lot more to come![/p]

notes.title: Concept art of Machine Mind's game environment
notes.content: [p]Today, we will show you several concept art illustrations exploring the environment of the game.[/p][p]Appearance of the map and its details: roads, obstacles, and other background objects that decorate the map or create specific detours.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/7662e81126c413188b18e6a74cbceeb8257e7602.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Simple sketch of the geography of a possible game world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/76d311c17ecb41e3ede0049c56caa211f43270cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A more detailed concept of the geography of a possible game world in a more discrete, block-based format.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/3a87d0a34c7485560197dc1afa9e872347c87d79.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The stylization of Machine Mind: minimalism and realism
notes.content: [p]A couple more of concept art illustrations that explore the stylization of Machine Mind: minimalism and realism.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/5f7280ac3d6a31f2c1bbcfbc4b9d1ccb2ed2e644.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/c8d93bd4969e12b0bb24765e79f144578933e3ef.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: A collection of concept arts: weapon mounts and rover equipment
notes.content: [p]The next set of concept arts: weapon mounts and rover equipment.[/p][p]Have you discovered anything from the demo version yet?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/af999174202e09dee146694b718cbd9c05887856.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/715cf56f0189fe05696ba0177de3d278c6f45d60.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: A selection of early concept art
notes.content: [p]Development is in full swing, and we’ll soon start sharing a glimpse of what’s coming in the game![/p][p]In the meantime, take a look at some early concept art — showcasing the overall visual style and potential in-game elements.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/770b8eeee4bd794369abac46c058a0e051efd3e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/cf89fc70f17270701eb75911774c0cea236423e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/870114587f7997904c7446c5a232f0173371e5bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/483d6c46e4b1a3c290dc4cee212558b13ecea940.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Machine Mind at the Games From Russia 2025 festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/aa78c31ba600fbb96dd6b66976ada5ad20e940f4.png[/img]

From May 1 to May 9, players have the chance to check out a wide range of new titles, try out demos, and purchase popular Russian games at a discount.

A demo version of Machine Mind will be presented at the festival, where players will have the opportunity to explore the starting biome, build and begin developing their base, and defend against raiders.
Automate processes using controllable machines and uncover all the secrets of this shattered world!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind/

Love RTS games? The festival has another strategy title in store for you, where you’ll build bases and manage resources!

The Scouring is a real-time strategy game where humans and orcs fight for dominance. Lead your army and fight for victory either solo or with friends. Wield magic, unleash cannons, and outsmart foes in dynamic battles — and don’t forget to defend from waves of undead at night!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3338950/The_Scouring/

Can’t decide which game you liked more? Why choose at all — you can have both! We’re already planning to launch a special bundle that includes both projects. Stay tuned so you don’t miss it!

notes.title: Machine Mind at the Strategems 2025 Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/26ae13e78e82c570598fe9f4a4107352628b8137.png[/img]

Are you a fan of strategy games? Then don’t miss Strategems 2025, now live on Steam!

From April 21 to 28, dive into a hand-picked selection of strategy titles, try out demos, and grab games from your wishlist at a discount!

The demo version of Machine Mind is already available, offering players the chance to explore the starting biome, build and begin developing their base, and fend off raiders.
You will fight, craft modules, build your transport, develop and protect your base. You can control other vehicles to automate operations. Discover all the secrets of the destroyed world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861590/Machine_Mind/

Another strategy game at the festival worth checking out is IRONHIVE — this card-based strategy game is set in a dying world. Build a colony, ensure the survival of your people, and create a legacy that will outlive you. As the Iron Overlord, you are their only hope!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679070/IRONHIVE

Can’t decide which game you liked more? Why choose at all — you can have both! We’re already planning to launch a special bundle that includes both projects. Stay tuned so you don’t miss it!
